name: Engine Kid
label: Revelation
lede: Seattle straight edge kids who wanted to be Slint, made a record in Steve Albini's basement and a twelve-minute Coltrane cover for Revelation, then split up, with their guitarist off to found Southern Lord and Sunn O))).

eras.title: Straight edge kids chasing Slint
eras.text: Greg Anderson had come up through Seattle's straight edge bands, Brotherhood and Amenity among them. Engine Kid was meant to sound like none of them: loud-quiet songs built on Slint's Spiderland, in a city that was busy with grunge.

years.h: Greg Anderson starts Engine Kid in Seattle
years.p: Guitarist and singer Greg Anderson, drummer Chris Vandebrooke and bassist Art Behrman, all veterans of local hardcore and punk bands, set out to play something unlike anything they'd done.
years.xp: Anderson's earlier bands included False Liberty, Brotherhood, Amenity, Statement and Galleon's Lap. Brotherhood and Galleon's Lap both had [[Nate Mendel|ba510f8c-f19d-41a2-921a-53afd27cfcbd]], later bassist in [[Sunny Day Real Estate|86b24e8f-a4d9-4c84-83ee-fde0d14ad9fa]] and the [[Foo Fighters|67f66c07-6e61-4026-ade5-7e782fad3a5d]].

years.h: Novocaine 7": Engine Kid put out their own debut
years.p: Engine Kid's self-released first single, the quiet/loud method already in place.

years.h: Brian "Krafty" Kraft replaces Art Behrman on bass
years.p: Southern Lord says Kraft made Engine Kid heavier, darker and far more dynamic.

eras.title: From Albini's basement to Bad Animals
eras.text: Two records on Seattle's C/Z in one year, one of them with Steve Albini, then a move to Revelation. A new drummer pushed Engine Kid toward metal and jazz, and the last album brought in horns from Silkworm.

years.h: Astronaut EP on C/Z, produced by John Goodmanson
years.p: Engine Kid's five-song first release for C/Z Records. Trouser Press heard Spiderland all over it.

years.h: Jade Devitt takes over drums from Chris Vandebrooke
years.p: Southern Lord calls Devitt's arrival Engine Kid's second phase: more power and wider sonic exploration.

years.src: Trouser Press · Southern Lord · The Stranger
years.h: Bear Catching Fish, recorded by Steve Albini in Chicago
years.p: Engine Kid's first album is cut with [[Steve Albini|a4d486bd-6020-4a36-9c7d-bf5ce174bcd1]], in a Chicago basement according to Trouser Press, and out on C/Z that summer.
years.xp:
Southern Lord's reissue notes describe Albini capturing the band raw, vulnerable and mammoth. Influences by then ran from [[Black Flag|9941a936-196a-4a62-ae53-a69cbc33f20e]] and [[Die Kreuzen|7550b236-f9c2-450c-81a6-fac63bf9d23e]] to Entombed and Miles Davis.

After Chris Vandebrooke's death, The Stranger called Engine Kid perhaps the closest Seattle came to Slint's emotional pull.

years.h: A split with Iceburn: Engine Kid's first Revelation record
years.p: Engine Kid share a Revelation record with Salt Lake City's [[Iceburn|b3aa7443-5572-4c1f-99e5-a91e13cd3e5b]], contributing three instrumental pieces.

While still in Engine Kid, Anderson meets [[Stephen O'Malley|d2db31eb-4469-4e8d-8ed2-b3c1bfff0c17]], and the two join Seattle death-doom band [[Thorr's Hammer|31c2d9e6-5f45-4b4e-9af1-aa46bbe3d4f9]] with Norwegian singer Runhild Gammelsæter.

years.h: Angel Wings: Engine Kid's last album, on Revelation
years.p: Recorded at Bad Animals in downtown Seattle with John Goodmanson. It closes on a twelve-minute cover of John Coltrane's Olé, with Silkworm's Joel Phelps on sax and Tim Midgett on trumpet.
years.xp:
Bill Herzog plays upright bass on the Coltrane piece, which appears on vinyl only. Trouser Press called the album titanic and punishing, and named a 78-second instrumental its high point.

Jade Devitt later said preparing for the session showed him what it felt like to be a complete musician.

years.h: Engine Kid split soon after Angel Wings
years.p: After four years of heavy touring, Engine Kid break up very shortly after Angel Wings is released, according to Southern Lord.
years.xp: Members of [[The Obsessed|aa043c18-c0a0-4cbe-bda0-8541f1fe59bd]] in Los Angeles had seen Engine Kid play and liked where Greg Anderson's taste was heading. Their jams became [[Goatsnake|ae720a02-629e-4e9b-98e7-d1f637bd5a49]]. With Stephen O'Malley, Anderson also formed [[Burning Witch|e5d4491d-1496-4efa-a5b9-e7be001b9f6a]] after Thorr's Hammer ended.

years.h: Live at the Fireside Bowl, Chicago, July 23, 1995
yt: Live at the Fireside Bowl, Chicago, July 23, 1995

eras.title: A label called Southern Lord
eras.text: Greg Anderson's next move turned Engine Kid's afterlife into a footnote to a much bigger story: the label that would put out Sunn O))), and eventually Engine Kid itself.

years.h: Greg Anderson and Stephen O'Malley found Southern Lord
years.p: The label for doom, sludge, drone and crust also becomes home to their own band, [[Sunn O)))|1d3da898-4fb4-4445-b704-cd7315e01789]]. Two decades later it reissues every Engine Kid record.

eras.title: A drummer lost, a vault opened
eras.text: The death of Engine Kid's first drummer brought the band's old friends back together, and Southern Lord went back into the tapes: remasters for charity, a six-LP box, and a song nobody remembered recording.

years.h: Engine Kid's first drummer, Chris Vandebrooke, is killed in LA
years.p: Chris Vandebrooke, Engine Kid's original drummer and later of Fairgrove, is killed in Griffith Park, Los Angeles. Southern Lord says he was murdered near a homeless encampment by the LA River.
years.xp: The Stranger described him as a respected, talented drummer who led an untraditional life. As of its January 2017 story, the LAPD had released no further details about the investigation; Seattle friends were planning a memorial show.

years.h: Engine Kid remasters raise money for LA's Midnight Mission
years.p: On Bandcamp Day, Southern Lord posts Brad Boatright remasters of Bear Catching Fish and Angel Wings as pay-what-you-want, all proceeds to the Midnight Mission shelter in Chris Vandebrooke's honor.

q: The reason it was left off the full-length album remains a mystery!
years.h: Everything Left Inside: the six-LP Engine Kid box
years.p: A Record Store Day box from Southern Lord with every Engine Kid record remastered, plus Angel Dust, a lost Angel Wings track found on the master tapes and mixed by Brad Wood.

years.h: Angel Wings turns 30 as a deluxe double LP
years.p: Southern Lord marks the anniversary of Engine Kid's last album with a remastered 2xLP in a gatefold jacket. Brian Kraft says it doesn't sound a day older than 25.
